steps.code:
# Now I'll parse the files and reorganize them. The format is "<date>__<file_name>.<extension>" -> "<file_name>/<date>.<extension>"
import os

base_dir = "~/documents/work/meetings/"

for file_path in files:
    # Get the filename from the path
    filename = os.path.basename(file_path)
    # Split into name and extension
    name, ext = os.path.splitext(filename)
    # Split the name by "__" to get date and file_name
    parts = name.split("__", 1)
    if len(parts) == 2:
        date, file_name = parts
        # Create the directory for file_name
        new_dir = f"{base_dir}{file_name}/"
        create_result = apis.file_system.create_directory(
            access_token=access_token,
            directory_path=new_dir,
            recursive=True
        )
        print(f"Created directory: {new_dir} - {create_result}")
        
        # Move the file to the new directory with date as filename
        new_file_path = f"{new_dir}{date}{ext}"
        move_result = apis.file_system.move_file(
            access_token=access_token,
            source_file_path=file_path,
            destination_file_path=new_file_path
        )
        print(f"Moved {file_path} -> {new_file_path}: {move_result}")
